card.name: Lotion and potion word endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'lotion(s)' or 'potion', such as 'ions' after 'lot' or 'otion' after 'L', mostly in skin-product lists. It also fires on 'Potion' or 'potion' in fiction.
